products.title: Ausom K30 VMP Electric Sccooter (DGT-Certified)
products.body_html:
• Go Further, Worry Less: Powered by a high-capacity battery, the K30 VMP electric scooter delivers up to 70 km of range on a single charge.
  • Power That Responds: Equipped with a peak 1100W motor, the K30 VMP Single Motor electric scooter for adults reaches default speeds of up to 20 km/h and delivers 24 Nm of torque for quick acceleration and strong climbing performance.
  • Smooth on Every Road: Crafted from aerospace-grade materials, the ShocFree® suspension system combines a high-strength front fork with an adjustable rear swingarm suspension.
  • Built for Everyday Commuting: Designed with convenience in mind, the K30 VMP  (DGT-Certified) electric scooter for adults features a foldable frame, making it easy to store, carry, or fit into your car trunk.
